name: I Want To Know
source:
Chris Mattix lives a lonely life up in Alaska when he runs afoul of a group of classmates turned gang members, which threatens his friendship with former leader Tyler Darden.  Complicating matters is mysterious old man Clemson Gault who might not even be human.
